messages:
miriam: Heads up - quant build `quant-v7-slim` just finished staging bake at 03:00 UTC. I want to propose pinning this bundle for the quiet window tonight (04:00-08:00). Thoughts?

kyle: nice, saw the smoke. perf numbers look ok on p50/p95. small regression in matmul path p99 (about +8ms).

jason: can you paste the smoke logs? curious if it's thermal-y or kernel ABI related.

miriam: tail of failing log: `ERR kv-cache miss spike at step 2048; matmul kernel fallback path observed` - looks like fallback to scalar path. not obviously thermal.

sara: re: pin - I'd prefer a staged pin for 2 hours then widen if stable. also we should add a release note line about the matmul fallback fix.

miriam: agreed. Proposed plan: 1) deploybot pin quant-v7-slim to night-bucket 2) hold for 2h staged traffic 3) if no regressed alerts, extend to full quiet window 4) one-line release note for platform docs.

deploybot: @miriam received. To confirm: command you want me to run is `deploybot pin --bundle quant-v7-slim --bucket quiet-window-night --ttl 4h --staged=true` ?

miriam: yes, run that but set ttl=2h initial and staged=true. I'll do the manual extension if signals look good.

kyle: add a canary route to <=1% traffic for the first 15m then 10% for remainder of staged.

jason: also add a quick telemetry gate: `matmul_p99 < baseline + 10ms` and `error_rate < 0.1%` - if either trips, auto-unpin.

sara: release note draft for console: "quant-v7-slim: improved memory/latency tradeoff; matmul fallback behavior tightened (watch p99)". short and actionable.

miriam: nice. who will own extending to full window?

kyle: i'll own extension and watch the heatmap.

ops-bot: FYI - gas-check scheduled vacuum job overlaps quiet window at 05:30 UTC. recommend we postpone vacuum to 09:00 UTC to avoid noisy background IO.

miriam: good catch - ops-bot please reschedule vacuum to 09:00.

ops-bot: done - vacuum moved to 09:00 UTC (ticket #INF-2245).

deploybot: pin applied: quant-v7-slim -> quiet-window-night; ttl=2h; staged=true; canary=1%/15m then 10%; telemetry-gates attached.

sara: will add the release note to the release-notes draft in the docs repo and ping PM for signoff.

jason: quick FYI: if the matmul p99 drift persists after 30m at 10% traffic, we should have a rollback play: `deploybot unpin --bundle quant-v7-slim --reason \"p99 drift\"` and roll back to `quant-v6` immediately.

miriam: agreed. add that to the top of the release note and to the ops runbook.

kyle: I'm going to watch the canary now. ping if anything spikes.

sara: pinged PM and they approved the note text.

miriam: thanks all - will follow up after the staged 2h.

kyle: can confirm first 15m canary at 1% is clean. moving to 10%.

(36 minutes later)

kyle: 35m at 10% still within gates. no alerts. leaning to extend.

miriam: extend TTL to full quiet window (until 08:00) and keep telemetry gates.

deploybot: TTL updated: quant-v7-slim until 1714521600 (08:00 UTC). staged=false.

jason: great - leaving rollback instructions in runbook.

sara: release notes updated and merged.

miriam: thanks team. closing thread unless we see regressions. :thumbsup:
